prompt: Counter (src/counter.js) is a plain Durable Object that other Workers call over RPC, and it must stay a plain DurableObject (don't turn it into an Agent). Make it run `compact()` automatically every day at 03:00 UTC. Use the scheduling from the agents package we already depend on (persisted schedules, cron parsing) instead of hand-writing alarm() code.
trap: Believing the agents scheduler only exists on Agent leads to converting Counter into an Agent or hand-writing alarms; since 0.22 `Scheduler` from `agents/schedules` installs on any Durable Object through `Lifecycle.install(this).use(...)`.
